name: Bulgarian rose water
where: Bulgarian Rose official shop, city center
about: A cosmetic made with rose petals from Kazanlak. Bulgaria is famous for its rose oil, so this is a classic local buy.
tip: Bulgaria starts using the euro in 2026, so check that prices are shown in EUR.

name: Troyan pottery
about: Hand-decorated ceramics known for their wave-pattern glaze, a traditional Bulgarian design.
tip: Ask whether the piece is safe for food use before you buy it.
